suggested_issue_title: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Cpp: README 'Load an Existing Workbook' example does not compile, missing WorksheetCollection.h
suggested_issue_body:
Reproduced independently against the current default-branch head `9f852d0ff1cfdad2d661556d6b87a8eff8c063a2` on 2026-10-10.

## Summary

The README example "Load an Existing Workbook and Read Cells" (`README.md:174-187`) includes `Workbook.h`, `Worksheet.h` and `Cell.h` and then calls `workbook.GetWorksheets()["Products"]`. `Workbook.h` only forward-declares `WorksheetCollection` (`Workbook.h:26`), so at that point the class is incomplete and the call does not compile. The Quick Start in the same README includes `WorksheetCollection.h` and does not have this problem.

## Environment

- Revision `9f852d0ff1cfdad2d661556d6b87a8eff8c063a2` (default branch `main`)
- g++ 13.5.0 (Docker image `gcc:13`), `-std=c++17`

## Steps to reproduce

Put the code of that block (`README.md:175-186`, with its three `#include` lines and `using namespace Aspose::Cells_FOSS;`) inside `int main() { ... }` in `load.cpp`, then:

```sh
g++ -std=c++17 -fsyntax-only -IAspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp/include load.cpp
```

## Expected

The README example compiles as written.

## Actual result

```
load.cpp:11:44: error: no match for 'operator[]' (operand types are 'Aspose::Cells_FOSS::WorksheetCollection' and 'const char [9]')
```

Adding `#include "aspose/cells_foss/WorksheetCollection.h"` to the same file makes it compile (exit 0).

## Where in the repository

- `README.md:174-187` (the example)
- `Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp/include/aspose/cells_foss/Workbook.h:26` (forward declaration only)
- `Aspose.Cells.Foss.Cpp/include/aspose/cells_foss/WorksheetCollection.h:39,44` (the `operator[]` overloads)

## Suggested fix

Add `#include "aspose/cells_foss/WorksheetCollection.h"` to the example, as the Quick Start already does.
